question: Can the six unchanged original experiments complete serially from their preserved full states after the successful postboot primitive check?
hypothesis: A013 restores evidence that basic GPU operations complete. This permits an original-training continuation attempt, while explicit progress and final-state checks remain necessary. Serial scheduling avoids concurrent compute contexts without claiming it cures the original failure.

sources.version: official tutorial read2026-11-15, checked against original trainer and installed2.12
sources.sections: General checkpoint, multiple modules, cross-device loading
sources.consequence: Copy the reviewed full checkpoint, including model/head, optimizer, scheduler and RNG; never warm-start weights alone. Preserve original source and artifact lineage.
Keep original package/runtime, seeds, per-step/per-epoch data order and backend settings. Do not promise bitwise equivalence to uninterrupted training.

A passed tiny copy is insufficient for training. Require fresh metric-step advancement and complete final states, and retain synchronization-related technical outcomes separately from scientific results.
One external CPU supervisor runs one original child, records exit and watches progress every60 seconds. It cannot approve its own result or launch a successor.
Signals apply only to the owned identity-matched child after a declared no-progress or wall-time stop. A transient observation failure is not proof of a stopped trainer.

differences: A010 first attempt failed before checkpoint load and remains untouched. A013 reboot and postboot primitive are reviewed. This record changes only isolated output paths and operational supervision for the same six logical experiments; the user's approved serial recovery scope persists.
contrary_evidence: The postboot primitive exercises no model, gradient or optimizer. Hangs may recur and bitwise training continuation is not guaranteed by checkpoint byte equality. Retained metric rows beyond a checkpoint must not be mistaken for new progress.

protocol.preparation: Verify six handoff checkpoints/configs/metrics against A013 hashes and original7dfc837 source/data against A010 manifest. Copy checkpoint.pt/config.json/metrics.jsonl unchanged into fresh outputs/balls/recovery_A014/name directories; preserve A005/A010 inputs and failed logs. Bind each clone to its exact passed CPU-preparation review. No new CPU loading/updates or GPU experiment is needed for unchanged bytes.
protocol.execution: One child only, original interpreter/cwd7dfc837/CLI arguments with only --out changed. Original env-unset list and PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=0, no SDMA override. Order L1n1,L1n3 from105000 then L0n1,n3,n6,L1n6 from155000. Require passed A013 primitive and preparation review; later runs require previous final continuation review passed. Verify source/data/config/checkpoint hashes immediately before launch; no concurrent GPU diagnostic or trainer.
protocol.monitor: CPU supervisor polls child and flushed metrics at60-second intervals. Accept progress only from a file modified after launch and a complete JSON metric row with step greater than the last observed resumed step, initialized to the checkpoint step. Preserve latest status, timestamps and identity. Ignore partial trailing rows; preserve parse/observation failures without treating them as child exit.
protocol.bounded_stop: After600 seconds with no verified step advancement, or24hours total runtime, record stop evidence and SIGTERM owned child; wait30 seconds then identity-checked SIGKILL only if necessary and wait10 seconds. No auto-restart, reset or environment change. An unreachable/unkillable child remains live until independently resolved. Keep source checkpoints and atomically saved continuation states.
protocol.result: Supervisor writes raw exit/elapsed/progress/lineage and awaits review. A zero exit alone is not success. Verify both final model303000 and full checkpoint303000, matching kind/n/config, finite tensors, optimizer/scheduler/RNG states, complete metric coverage and source/data lineage before literature-reviewing a continuation passed. All six final artifacts then receive unchanged A003 numerical checks from pinned gated source.
protocol.verification: Syntax and CPU-only checks of immutable clone/source/config/data hashes and gate bindings; test the monitor's retained-row/partial-row behavior before launch. Observe actual first new steps. No new model-performance hypothesis or CPU training fallback.

success: Each continuation completes original303000 total updates with verified final/full state and reviewed operational outcome. Only subsequent A003 and scientific evaluations support numerical/performance claims.
stop: Stop on incompatible evidence, conflicting compute work, child failure, repeated no-progress or wall cap. Review before any successor; no silent retry or self-approved review.
